ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels forming the base layer, with high-intensity (white) features covering approximately 30-35% of the surface area. High macro-level contrast between the black pigmentation and white scar tissue.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling and large contiguous patches are concentrated along the trailing edge of the right lobe. High-intensity linear and circular clusters are distributed semi-randomly across the dark medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-point with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire length. Notable jagged peaks and valleys present on the distal third of both the left and right lobes, distinct from the smooth water-line background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, ending in sharp distal tapers at the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle scars) localized primarily in the dark-pigmented central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of white, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths, appearing as intersecting 'scratches' across the dark field of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, high-density linear and circular scarring covering the majority of the visible ventral surface; no clear evidence of major lobe amputations or missing large-scale tissue chunks.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density of linear rake marks creates a unique 'web-like' visual texture that obscures the underlying solid dark pigmentation more significantly than typical species patterns.
